pluginInstallFix.symptom: Plugin request aborted after authorizing an install from the public repository
pluginInstallFix.cause: Tauri production CSP injects script hashes, disabling unsafe-inline and blocking the inline srcdoc bootstrap; the install health check aborts after 10 seconds.
pluginInstallFix.fix: Load only the trusted host bootstrap through a data URL with the existing frame nonce. Plugin code remains in an opaque-origin Worker; CSP, permissions and package signatures are unchanged.
pluginInstallFix.requiredPublicationChecks: The pre-push hook reruns formatting, lint, type checking and the complete unit suite. The tag workflow gates publication on all platform builds and required checks, including the new WebKit native CSP gate.

iosConnectionCompatibilityFix.symptom: AbortSignal.any is not a function when testing an iOS library connection
iosConnectionCompatibilityFix.cause: The connection probe and authenticated HTTP broker called AbortSignal.any directly, which is absent in the reported WebKit runtime.
iosConnectionCompatibilityFix.fix: Move the upstream anySignal helper into shared utilities and use it for both plugin paths. Retain cancellation through streamed bodies and redirect hops, and detach input listeners on abort or explicit cleanup.
